svg.text: CJ3 "Sale to Bank to Books" · context package · proof v0.1 · 6 Nov 2026
Kobas: tab, payments by method, discounts,
tips, receipts, cash log, Z, Xero importer
Dojo terminals (Kobas Connect; stand-alone PDQ on some venues)
Kobas /data reports: cash log, sales mix, item sales (bot user)
Slerp: shop, Stripe checkout, order webhook
Deliveroo: holds guest payment, weekly statement
Deliverect: Slerp and Deliveroo orders into Kobas
Dojo acquiring: batch, settle T+n, fees (pink 9)
Company bank accounts, one per legal entity;
Xero: 6 orgs (venue to org map, pink 7): sales journal,
Hubdoc: purchase, commission and fee invoices into Xero
Kobas Xero importer per venue (xero_enabled, pink 13)
Google Sheets: Auto Cash Up, 3 Daily Z Reports,
A6 Site manager: counts, declares, closes the day
A7 Finance: Monica directs, Junna sales input,
Lee Ting checks; MA by the 7th
A3 Marketing: reconciles Slerp and Deliveroo payouts
Safe, float, petty cash at the site (pink 8)
Cash deposit route: branch or collection (pink 8)
«provides» Se10 Payment · Se11 Sales Ledger · Se18 Cash Up

Infrastructure (lane 1): vendor cloud for Kobas, Dojo, Worldpay, Stripe, Deliveroo, Deliverect, Xero, Hubdoc · bank portals and feeds · on-site: tills, terminals, safe · GitHub cloud and Google Sheets for Co18 / Co26 · Service Contracts: none yet, candidates on page 2

Open before this package is final: 7 venue to Xero org map · 8 cash route · 9 Dojo settlement and fees · 10 Stripe payout · 11 Deliveroo statement and capture · 12 bank accounts per entity · 13 Kobas Xero importer scope
14 tips / service charge posting · 15 refunds, deposits, vouchers · 16 daily reconciliation owner · 1 QR acquirer (CJ2)

Confirmed: Dojo via Kobas Connect (extraction); xero_enabled per venue, 6 orgs (extraction); Slerp and Deliveroo in the cash log under Delivery, marketing reconciles payouts (Michael 6 Nov); Payments = Sales rule (Kobas help); MA by the 7th, Junna sales input (Finance Task Manual).
